neutralRoleModelRequirement: Derived from I-001/I-002/I-003/I-004/I-005/I-010/I-011/I-012/I-031/I-030: the universal layer must define (1) a closed, domain-neutral ROLE VOCABULARY — ACTOR, MEMBER, OWNER, ADMINISTRATOR, OPERATOR, MANAGER, SUPERVISOR, CONTRIBUTOR, REVIEWER, APPROVER, AUDITOR, WORKER, AGENT, SERVICE, SYSTEM — owned by the platform (P02/P08), never by a runtime; (2) a DIRECTIONAL MAPPING CONTRACT: domain runtimes declare mappings FROM their local roles TO neutral roles via DomainDefinition.roleMappings (Scholar: principal->ADMINISTRATOR, teacher->CONTRIBUTOR, bursar->OPERATOR, driver->WORKER, student/parent->MEMBER; Restaurant fixture: manager->ADMINISTRATOR/OWNER, cashier->OPERATOR, service_staff->WORKER, runner->WORKER) — the platform never learns a domain role name; (3) CAPABILITY-BASED AUTHORIZATION: capability codes and the capability gate evaluate against neutral roles/capability grants resolved from cg_role_assignment/cg_role_grant, with runtime-scoped feature declarations replacing both the hard-coded 'r001' check and MEMBERSHIP_FOR_NAV_KIND; (4) NEUTRAL TENANT MEMBERSHIP PRIMITIVES in the database: get_my_tenant_id() and a tenant-role/tenant-admin predicate over universal membership tables, replacing get_my_school_id()/is_school_admin() as the gate for every universal cg_ substrate RPC and unlocking tenant-scoped RLS on cg_org_unit/cg_org_membership (I-007); (5) RUNTIME-DECLARED WORKSPACE KINDS: the nav/workspace kind vocabulary is contributed per runtime (nav-registry contribution model), not a fixed Scholar kind enum, so DomainDefinition workspaces validate against the declaring runtime's kinds; (6) NEUTRAL IDENTITY ACTOR: IdentityActor carries tenantRef + neutral roles; domain adapters (Scholar first) translate identity-store rows (users.school_id/users.role) into it at the boundary.
restaurantFixtureVerdict: NO — not today. The data substrate can represent a restaurant without kernel changes: cg_entity/cg_relationship/cg_event/cg_observation are domain-neutral (I-006), cg_org_profile/cg_workspace/cg_org_unit are neutral (I-007/I-008), DomainDefinition + restaurant.ts prove the ontology maps as configuration (I-030), and the fixture is correctly quarantined (its only consumer is tests/unit/domain-config-restaurant.test.ts). What leaks is the ENTIRE access/authorization path: (1) every universal-substrate RPC (cg_role_assignment, cg_org_profile, workforce positions) requires is_school_admin()/get_my_school_id() resolved from users.school_id — a restaurant tenant has no such row semantics (I-002/3/4/5); (2) the universal role vocabulary IS the Scholar AppRole set, forcing restaurant.service_staff->teacher and restaurant.runner->driver (I-010/I-031/I-030); (3) workspace kinds are Scholar nav kinds — restaurant-service must declare kind 'teacher' (I-012/I-013); (4) the capability gate hard-codes runtime 'r001', so no restaurant capability code can ever pass (I-012). These are exactly the kernel-side changes the neutral role model must make; after I-002/I-010/I-012 the SAME substrate hosts a restaurant with zero further kernel edits.
scholarBoundaryVerdict: NO — not every Scholar-specific assumption is traceable to Scholar ownership. Properly owned (keep): frontend/src/lib/runtime/scholar-*.ts (catalog, events, workforce, consumption — all self-describing, kernel stays valid if deleted), routes/_authenticated role route trees (I-029), 20260907000100/20260907000600 runtime catalog migrations (data-only, namespaced), Scholar doc positioning in CONSTITUTION/DEPENDENCY/REALITY (I-032/33/34). Leaks (Scholar assumptions living OUTSIDE Scholar): public.users schema + get_my_school_id/is_school_admin helpers (I-001/I-002); universal cg_ substrate RPCs gated on Scholar helpers (I-003/I-004/I-005); roles.ts AppRole as the platform vocabulary (I-010); identity-actor.ts SCHOOL_ROLES/schoolId (I-011); capability-gate MEMBERSHIP_FOR_NAV_KIND + 'r001' (I-012); ScholarNavKind aliased as the platform RuntimeNavKind (I-013); tenant-core TenantType education kinds (I-014); paystack adapter school_id/fee_id metadata (I-016); kernel define-phase firstRuntime 'runtime:scholar' (I-019); Control-Plane platform.org.tsx implemented under lib/scholar/ (I-025); universal runtime.tsx surface wired to Scholar server functions (I-027).
